profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv that trades under the ticker WIX. According to its website, it offers a free website builder that the company describes as easy to use, with more than 2,000 business-ready templates that can be customized manually or with AI, a custom domain, and built-in AI tools. The site also says users can sell products, services, and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins, and that specialized AI agents are available to support business growth.

The company's own material places AI in two roles: built-in tools inside the website builder and separate AI agents aimed at business operations. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or individual products are recorded for Wix in the facts held alongside this profile.
